title: Slab model construction and relaxation
action: Obtain bulk α-Fe2O3 crystal structure. Construct an O3-terminated (0001) slab with 12 Fe layers and ~12 Å vacuum, substitute one surface Fe by Ir, create an adjacent oxygen vacancy, and perform DFT+U geometry optimization with antiferromagnetic Fe ordering.
description: Construct and relax the Ir1/FeOx slab model with oxygen vacancy.

title: O2 adsorption and dissociative configuration
action: Place O2 on the relaxed slab. Compute DFT+U energies for molecular O2 adsorption and dissociative O2 adsorption (one O on Ir, the other healing the vacancy). Confirm dissociative adsorption preference and obtain the dissociated geometry.
description: Calculate O2 adsorption energetics and identify the dissociative adsorption geometry.

title: Transition state and barrier: L–H first CO2 on high-valent Ir
action: From the dissociative O2 geometry (three-fold O-coordinated Ir), co-adsorb CO with OB on Ir. Locate the transition state for CO(ad) + OB → CO2 using NEB or dimer method. Compute the activation barrier.
description: Compute the L–H activation barrier for first CO2 formation on high-valent Ir.

title: Transition state and barrier: L–H first CO2 on low-valent Ir
action: From a two-fold O-coordinated Ir site (low-valent), co-adsorb CO with an O atom on Ir. Locate the transition state for CO(ad) + O → CO2 and compute the activation barrier.
description: Compute the L–H activation barrier for first CO2 formation on low-valent Ir.

title: Transition state and barrier: Eley–Rideal first CO2
action: Model gas-phase CO reacting with vertically adsorbed OB on Ir. Locate the transition state for CO(gas) + OB → CO2 and compute the activation barrier.
description: Compute the E–R activation barrier for first CO2 formation.

title: Rate-determining second CO2 formation
action: After first CO2 desorption, adsorb a second CO on Ir. Locate the transition state for CO(ad) + OC → CO2 (rate-determining step) and compute its activation barrier.
description: Compute the activation barrier for the rate-determining second CO2 formation.

title: Record computed activation barriers
action: Collect the four activation barriers computed in Steps 3–6 and write them to /app/outputs/activation_barriers.json.
description: JSON object containing the four DFT-computed activation barriers for CO oxidation on Ir1/FeOx.
output_schema: object with keys L_H_high_valent, L_H_low_valent, E_R, second_CO2, each a floating-point number in eV
